product_one_liner.value: CoLab is an AI-powered design-review platform for mechanical engineering and hardware development teams to review CAD and drawings, capture expert feedback and engineering knowledge, and make faster design decisions.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link or public plan page was found; the pricing URL did not return a page and the contact page routes prospects to Sales.

employee_band.notes: The October 28, 2026 company announcement reports more than 250 employees.

eng_blog.notes: The blog is predominantly product and marketing content. One clear engineer-authored product-implementation article was found, by CTO Jeremy Andrews; the two-post threshold was not met.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live opening: Senior 3D & AI Systems Software Developer.

model_provider.value: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud
model_provider.notes: CoLab explicitly names these AI service providers; it does not identify specific model versions on this page.

last_funding.notes: March 19, 2026 government announcement confirms CAD 1,000,000 repayable financing. USD 728,000 is the USD amount reported in the company-profile financial record, not a conversion supplied by the government. This is later than the November 2025 Series C.

raised_18mo.notes: The March 19, 2026 repayable financing falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

launched_6mo.notes: September 30, 2026: announced the release of Generative Artifacts. The future Generative CAD product is not counted as a completed launch.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Tom Greever joined as SVP of Design in January 2026; his profile also contains an April 2026 announcement that he joined.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Revenue Operations Systems posting names Salesforce and the revenue-tool categories directly; Salesloft/Outreach are alternatives, while Chili Piper, Zendesk, HubSpot and LinkedIn Sales Navigator appear as desirable experience rather than confirmed deployments.
